about: Installing through the session (docs/adr/0030-installing-applications.mdx, decisions 9 and 16): a store with the store and updates grants (sample/StoreProbe.tsx) asks through OxyOSSystem; each request, citing the press that asked it, crosses the host, the compositor (which checks the grant and the input) and the session's side (oxyos_compositor::installs, which reads it strictly), and is answered to the store alone. With no install service on this machine every answer says so, as the session tells it, never a fake install; a change the person asked for (Install) first shows the shell's sheet saying the service is not running, with one button, and the store's answer (told: the person was told) comes once it is pressed. A check or a read shows no sheet.

steps.name: Install, pressed: the session has no install service to ask, and the shell's sheet says so, with one button and nothing to confirm; the store's answer waits for the person

texts: No se puede instalar la app
El servicio que instala las apps en este ordenador no está funcionando. Inténtalo de nuevo cuando vuelva a estar disponible.
